acceptance_criteria: web_pki_policy returns without panic. All listed constraint tests pass.
close_reason: web_pki_policy implemented: 398-day cap, SHA-1 excluded, min 2048-bit RSA, require SAN, require serverAuth EKU, max_path_len=2. 21 tests pass in pkix-profiles.
description:
Implement web_pki_policy(now_unix) in pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs to return a ValidationPolicy that enforces CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements for TLS Server Certificates (current version: v2.0+).

Constraints to set (using the new ValidationPolicy fields from PKIX-ken.1):
- max_validity_secs: 398 * 86400  (398 days, per BR §6.3.2 — effective 2020-09-01)
- allowed_signature_algs: exclude SHA-1 based OIDs. Specifically deny:
    sha1WithRSAEncryption  (1.2.840.113549.1.1.5)
    ecdsa-with-SHA1        (1.2.840.10045.4.1)
  Allow: sha256WithRSAEncryption, sha384WithRSAEncryption, sha512WithRSAEncryption, ecdsa-with-SHA256, ecdsa-with-SHA384, ecdsa-with-SHA512
- min_rsa_key_bits: 2048  (BR §6.1.5)
- require_subject_alt_name: true  (BR §7.1.4.2 — SAN must be present and non-empty on leaf)
- required_leaf_eku: [id-kp-serverAuth]  (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1)

Also set:
- max_path_len: 2  (BR §7.1.1 — max 2 intermediates for publicly-trusted TLS)

Remove the unimplemented!() panic and the # Limitations note about it. Update the rustdoc to list the exact constraints enforced.

Tests (in pkix-profiles or pkix-chain integration tests):
- A cert with 399-day validity is rejected
- A cert signed with SHA-1 is rejected
- A cert with a 1024-bit RSA key is rejected
- A cert without SAN is rejected
- A cert missing id-kp-serverAuth EKU is rejected
- A conforming cert passes
title: Implement web_pki_policy (CA/B Forum TLS BR)
